_comment: Single source of truth for Python runtime imports required at app boot. Every entry in requirements.txt must appear here, translated through tools/release_check.py::PACKAGE_IMPORT_MAP. Read by bsd/install.sh (post-venv import check), tools/release_check.py, tools/runtime_preflight.py, and tools/check_manifest.py — the last of which fails the install/release gate when this file drifts from requirements.txt. Edit this file when you edit requirements.txt; do not duplicate the list anywhere else.
